responsibility: This definition file is the master table of GCC’s legacy __sync_* builtins and newer __atomic_* builtins. It enumerates overloaded generic names and size-specific variants, assigns each one its builtin enum identifier, type signature, and attribute set, and serves as the source for generating builtin registration and dispatch tables for atomic read-modify-write operations, compare/exchange, fences, lock-free queries, and related synchronization primitives.
